announcements.headline: REC Silicon - Announces the extension of a USD 50.0M Facility Loan
announcements.insight: REC Silicon extends a facility loan following its compulsory acquisition and extraordinary general meeting. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on how this financing supports the post-acquisition structure.

announcements.headline: REC Silicon ASA - Extraordinary general meeting held
announcements.insight: The compulsory acquisition follows the June notice of meeting. This suggests a change in control is underway for shareholders.

announcements.headline: REC SILICON ASA - COMPULSORY ACQUISITION OF SHARES
announcements.insight: REC Silicon is being compulsorily acquired. This follows the June 2026 AGM notice, indicating a completed takeover process.

announcements.headline: REC Silicon - Notice of Annual General Meeting 2026
announcements.insight: Shareholders should watch for the agenda items to be discussed at the Annual General Meeting.
